notes.text: The Bavli records both allocations of the offices. Heilprin follows the Sages’ reading.
The checked Sifra has שלמניציה with a recorded variant שלמצו. Heilprin writes שלמצי.
The checked Ta’anit places the rain account at 23a:2. It names Shimon and lists two nights, with no queen named.
The checked Kohelet Rabbah spells her name שלמתו. Heilprin records שלמתי and proposes comparison with שלציון.
The checked Vayikra Rabbah reads שלמצה. Heilprin writes שלצמה here.
Rashi at Sanhedrin 44b includes the witnesses’ recantation. Yerushalmi Sanhedrin 6:3:5 gives the son’s separate response to his father.
The two Yerushalmi discussions are numbered 6:3:5 and 6:6:5 in the checked edition.
The checked fourth chapter has the eyewitness narrative at 4:9:2. The son’s case is in chapter six.
The Yerushalmi has him working with flax and gives the blessing he wished to hear. Heilprin says gallnuts and quotes the seller speaking.
